'''Wilson Fisher What hunt down has turned into''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Wilson Fisher]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18304">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18304 What hunt down has turned into], DeckTech (Wilson "Your mom" Fisher, 13 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18304/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18304/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wilson Fisher]]
* '''Published:''' 13 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''What hunt down has turned into''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}

* '''Strategy:''' After the release of Tatooine and Corsucant Hunt Down and destroy the jedi has turn into a podracing/dueling machine.

== Original post ==

'''What hunt down has turned into'''
* '''Author:''' Wilson "Your mom" Fisher
* '''Published:''' August 13, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' After the release of Tatooine and Corsucant Hunt Down and destroy the jedi has turn into a podracing/dueling machine.

=== Strategy ===

hello everyone

Well, first off, thank you for taking time to look at (and hopfuly review) my deck.

Well, here is how I play this virsion of Hunt down

I start off Watto's box and just podrace away.  Stop little ani for getting his racer started.  Your destinys look like this

0=4

1=12

2=2

3=3

4=0

5=20

6=1

7=6

Nice little spread don't ya say?  Well, bump into Anakin until he is right back at the staring line.  Get out sites with you advisor and bring down Vader and maul, waste characters with the droids sitting at the lars mosture farm adding one to each of their weapons destinys.  Sound good?  Ok, I will edit this page more once I have more time.  Later days

Wilson
